qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 2ae93fb and serialized rechecks of the signed fix commit 3f9f8ea found every finding resolved and left no optional item open. Correctness raised one minor scoped-coverage finding, fixed: 化粧's note on how the kanji combine dropped EN's statement that け + しょう are on readings, so it now reads «Онные чтения здесь — け + しょう» (Digital Daijisen 化 lists ケ among its on readings and gives 化粧 under ケ). Its initial correctness verdict was UNVERIFIED only because no exact Russian dictionary headword was located for «зачётная единица», 単位's academic-credit sense (limit L1). The coordinator supplied normative evidence: Order No. 245 of the Russian Ministry of Science and Higher Education of 6 April 2021, paragraphs 15–16, which measure programme workload in зачётные единицы and define the unit in hours. The correctness recheck closed L1 substantively and kept a source-type limit: no dictionary headword was found, and the card claims no numerical equivalence with Japanese credits. Consistency reported no findings: titles, exclusions, links, manifest hashes and intake agreed, and it classified the RU-introduced guards without finding any unjustified. Its optional 単に–だけ/ばかり guards were adopted; its optional 協力–援助/世話 and 化学–科学 guards were declined, and it withdrew them in its recheck. Comprehensibility raised two minor findings, both fixed: 博士 kept the English abbreviation «(PhD)», now removed because «обладателя докторской степени» already states the sense; and 単に's title and gloss «исключительно», which in bare Russian commonly means "exceptionally" (名人 in this batch says «исключительно умело»), so the title and heading now read «просто (не более того); всего лишь» and the meaning line «просто, всего лишь, только» (JMdict 単に: simply; merely; only; solely; Kuznetsov «всего лишь»). Its optional reading parentheses in 共同 were adopted. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 9 EN exclusions across 8 lists are retained. Seven direct, one-sided exclusions on six new cards cover reviewed RU title overlaps and sense neighbours. Required (4): 原–野 (open field or plain), 博物館–美術館 (Russian «музей» covers art museums), 及ぼす–影響 (influence) and 単なる–単に (near-identical restrictive meaning; after the fix they share the exact segment «всего лишь»). Conservative (3): 叱る–注意 (注意's reprimand sense) and 単に–だけ and 単に–ばかり (bare «только» and «одно лишь» glosses). These are the consistency reviewer's classes; the author had called 博物館–美術館, 及ぼす–影響 and 単なる–単に conservative. The two 単に guards were added in the fix, adopting the consistency reviewer's optional suggestion, and its recheck confirmed them and found no other title sharing «всего лишь». Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined optional items: the consistency reviewer's guards 協力–援助/世話 and 化学–科学, because 協力 shares no title segment or stem with «помощь» and its title avoids «содействие», and «химия» and «наука» are not mutually defensible answers while the 化学 card already contrasts the homophones; the reviewer withdrew both in its recheck. The comprehensibility reviewer's optional notes on 名人's «знатока», which echoes 博士's title «знаток» (label hygiene only: 博士 already excludes 名人, and 名人's examples say «мастер»), and on «JMdict помечает» in 博士 (the named, linked dictionary is more precise, and the phrasing occurs in published cards). Its remaining notes (原 «ручью», 叱る's 𠮟る variant note, 博士's reading notes and 可能 «Можно ли») were judged not to be defects by the reviewer itself. No reviewer finding remains open.
